purpose: Six distinct public yukkuri explainer channels define observable format families for six original, local-only benchmark reproductions.
selection_rule: Use only observable mechanics. Each reproduction must use an original script, original or independently licensed assets, and its own artifact identity.

authority.note: The 2026-08-04 user direction authorizes building all six original local reproductions. It does not authorize public upload or publication.

observable_contract.narration_model: measure host narration and location-led explanation
observable_contract.visual_grammar: measure live property footage, detail inserts, and spatial orientation
observable_contract.subtitle_grammar: measure title and explanatory subtitle hierarchy
observable_contract.audio_grammar: measure narration, location sound, and music balance
observable_contract.source_attribution: measure property facts and description-link practice

observable_contract.narration_model: two-speaker dialogue: one role advances the case and the other tests mechanism, numbers, and consequences
observable_contract.chapter_model: concrete question hook, hazard or need, system plan, construction constraint, mechanism and operation, observed effect, remaining risk, recap
observable_contract.visual_grammar: original route maps, section diagrams, engineering-number cards, construction timeline, and consequence summary; no benchmark frames
observable_contract.subtitle_grammar: two-line readable dialogue subtitles with dates, dimensions, flow, and level differences stated in speech
observable_contract.asset_switching: one engineering thesis per chapter, with evidence-to-diagram transitions rather than decorative rapid cuts
observable_contract.audio_grammar: YMM4 two-character TTS with no benchmark voice, audio, music, or effects
observable_contract.pacing: question, mechanism, numeric evidence, and consequence cycle repeated across six visual chapters
observable_contract.source_attribution: tracked claim registry points to primary public-agency sources; source media is not embedded
observable_contract.intro_outro: visible infrastructure question at the opening and an ordered mechanism-plus-limit recap at the close

channels.channel_name: ゆっくり歴史解説チャンネル

observable_contract.narration_model: bounded authoring contract: two-speaker dialogue in which one role advances the chronology and the other tests causes, date transitions, and institutional consequences
observable_contract.chapter_model: concrete present-day question, precondition, international turning point, domestic ordinance, implementation, later scope change, present-day consequence, ordered recap
observable_contract.visual_grammar: original date cards, map and meridian diagrams, ordinance cards, and before-after institutional summaries; no benchmark frames
observable_contract.subtitle_grammar: two-line readable dialogue subtitles with years, ordinance numbers, longitude, and effective dates stated in speech
observable_contract.asset_switching: one causal or chronological thesis per chapter, with explicit date transitions rather than decorative rapid cuts
observable_contract.audio_grammar: YMM4 two-character TTS with no benchmark voice, audio, music, or effects
observable_contract.pacing: question, dated event, reason, and consequence cycle across seven chronological chapters
observable_contract.source_attribution: tracked claim registry points to public institutional sources; source media is not embedded
observable_contract.intro_outro: present-day meridian question at the opening and an ordered rule-change-plus-present-system recap at the close

observable_contract.chapter_model: hook, unit, near scale, solar scale, interstellar scale, galactic scale, implication, recap
observable_contract.visual_grammar: original scale diagrams, labeled cards, and numeric comparisons; no benchmark frames
observable_contract.subtitle_grammar: two-line readable subtitles with numeric emphasis
observable_contract.asset_switching: one visual thesis per dialogue beat, grouped by scale
observable_contract.audio_grammar: YMM4 two-character TTS; no benchmark audio or voice copy
observable_contract.pacing: approximately one question-answer beat every 15 to 25 seconds
observable_contract.source_attribution: source card and review manifest list primary institutional references
observable_contract.intro_outro: question hook, ordered recap, and explicit close

channels.channel_name: ゆっくり災難資料館〖裏〗

observable_contract.chapter_model: measure conditions, timeline, failure chain, outcome, and lessons
observable_contract.visual_grammar: measure route diagrams, object cutaways, chronology cards, and safety summaries
observable_contract.subtitle_grammar: measure time, casualty, cause, and lesson emphasis
observable_contract.asset_switching: measure tension and evidence transition cadence
observable_contract.audio_grammar: measure narration, restrained effects, and background music balance

observable_contract.chapter_model: measure document context, contents, claims, critique, and legacy
observable_contract.visual_grammar: measure book imagery, quotations, diagrams, and source cards
observable_contract.subtitle_grammar: measure quotation, title, author, and caveat hierarchy
observable_contract.audio_grammar: measure narration and background music balance
observable_contract.source_attribution: measure bibliography, quotation, and correction practice

current_gate.completed: Six channel identities and six distinct format-family contracts are locked and machine validated. Science and civil engineering each have an original local-viewable reproduction with an exact successor YMMP/MP4 receipt, unchanged voice/subtitle sequence, full decode, and sampled-frame readbacks.
current_gate.next_slice: Keep the exact science and civil successors pending artifact-bound human review, while measuring and authoring the chronological-history family on a separate original artifact identity.
